data.name: Ayanv
data.gender_notes: Ayanv is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ayanv is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ayan', meaning 'to go', 'travel', or 'journey'. It is a name for a boy, filled with the spirit of adventure and movement. The name Ayanv carries the meaning “Journey, Travel” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ayanv usually hope their child will grow to embody journey, travel and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ayanv is a name that symbolizes the journey of life and the continuous pursuit of wisdom and knowledge.
data.etymology: Ayanv belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Journey, Travel.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ayanv total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

historical_references.reference: The name Ayanv occurs in the Hindu epic Mahabharata, in the context of the Kurukshetra War. Ayanv is mentioned as the name of a sage who lived during the Mahabharata period and had the power to throw a curse on Bhishma Pitamaha (Grandfather of Bhishma), the supreme commander of the Kaurava army. This curse prevented Bhishma from lying down on a bed, as a result of which he chose to lie on a bed of arrows.

Another reference to the name Ayanv can be found in the Hindu scripture, the Puranas. In this context, Ayanv is mentioned as the name of a king who ruled over the region of Kashmir during the Satya Yuga (Golden Age). Ayanv is said to have performed great tapasya (penance) and was blessed with a boon that made him immortal, making him rule over the region for several thousand years.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Ayanv' is derived from the Hindu mythology and means 'ruler of the four directions'. In modern context, this name holds significance in various fields. In the realm of astrology, Ayanv is often used as a username or handle by astrologers on social media platforms like Instagram and Twitter to build a brand and reach a wider audience. In the spirituality niche, it is adopted by individuals seeking to establish a strong personal identity and connect with their roots. On YouTube, Ayanv can be seen as a title for videos on mindfulness, meditation, and self-improvement. Overall, the name 'Ayanv' symbolizes power, direction, and authenticity, making it a popular choice among users across multiple platforms in the areas of astrology, spirituality, and personal branding.
